title: VAMINT Student Portal
description: A centralized hub for club members to track tasks, review code, and coordinate schedules.
longDescription: The VAMINT Student Portal is a comprehensive tool built to coordinate active developers, manage repository permissions, and handle event RSVPs natively. It features real-time notifications, task assignment boards, and code review integration.

title: Aurora LLM Compiler
description: An experimental compiler translation system mapping natural language prompts into optimized WASM byte code.
longDescription: Aurora utilizes custom low-level transformers to convert structured pseudo-code prompts into binary WASM files, running high-performance operations in sandboxed web clients. It bridges standard assembly logic with human-understandable specifications.

title: Sentinel IoT Gateway
description: A secure firmware gateway encrypting communication channels for microcontrollers in university lab systems.
longDescription: Sentinel IoT Gateway addresses security breaches in standard ESP32/Arduino implementations by setting up an encrypted local VPN tunnel and secure firmware signing, preventing arbitrary code execution over wireless channels.
